csv_project_name: Housing Plan Implementation Consultant Svcs Phase 1
csv_scope_of_work: The Town of Lake City, Colorado, in cooperation with Hinsdale County, Colorado, is requesting proposals from qualified consultants with expertise in affordable housing governance, development, and policy to provide professional services to implement Phase 1 of the Lake City & Hinsdale County Comprehensive Housing Plan. The purpose of this RFP is to select a qualified consultant to assist the Town and County with Phase 1 implementation of the Housing Plan. Phase 1 is intended to move the Housing Plan from planning into implementation by helping the community establish governance structures, identify and pursue funding, advance priority housing policies and goals, and develop sustainable revenue tools.
csv_disciplines_requested: Urban Studies/Planning/Design, Housing & Urban Development, Planning/Master Planning
